layer_html: Optics / Connectivity · optical isolator — Faraday-rotator garnet loop 5
chokepoint_html: The Faraday-rotator garnet crystal inside every optical isolator — genuinely tight at the crystal layer, but the cash is banked one hump downstream, and the link carries un-hedged obsolescence risk if CPO designs the isolator out. A study/watchlist run, not a monopoly-toll run

layer_html: Compute fabric · thin-wafer handling — grind · carrier · debond loop 6
chokepoint_html: Ultra-thin wafer grind / temporary carrier bond / laser debond — the handling chain every stacked die passes through (DISCO on grind, 15/20 at that stage). The chain composite is looser than its tightest member and branch-conditional on the specification fork. NO POSITION-GRADE CANDIDATE

layer_html: Power delivery · on-site generation — hot-section superalloy casting loop 5
chokepoint_html: Gas-turbine hot-section superalloy investment casting (~70–80% PCC + Howmet, est.) — 2–6% rhenium with no substitute, and the 5–7 year grid queue is what drives datacenters to on-site generation in the first place

Metal TIM at the die interface and its Ga/In feedstock — tightness today with obsolescence tomorrow as the honest frame; no clean listed owner, an 'admire, don't own' across three links (SOLS/VNP/HEN)

layer_html: Networking silicon · optical circuit switching — free-space optics loop 5
chokepoint_html: The OCS free-space optical path (MEMS mirror + collimation) — real and inflecting, but the listed systems names have already run hard (LITE +740% 1Y, Recognition→). NO POSITION-GRADE CANDIDATE

layer_html: Substrates & materials · CMP consumables — pad + slurry loop 5
chokepoint_html: The CMP polishing pad (the binding sub-link) plus slurry — a strong, structurally-growing chokepoint, but tightness that the listed vehicles have already priced
InP epitaxy / MOCVD tool (AIXTRON ~70–90% adv. photonic)
